Command.Comment: RAGIN EDGE live positive mTLS probe to CORE (no secrets)

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
CERTS_READY=0
if [ -n "${RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE:-}" ] && [ -n "${RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE:-}" ] && [ -n "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE:-}" ]; then
  if [ -f "${RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "${RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE:-}" ] && [ -f "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE:-}" ]; then
    CERTS_READY=1
  fi
fi
echo CERTS_READY=$CERTS_READY
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
echo TMPDIR=$TMPDIR
if [ "$CERTS_READY" = "1" ] && command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "ATTEMPT_OPENSSL_S_CLIENT_EDGE_TO_CORE"
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "${RAGIN_MTLS_CA_FILE}" \
    -cert "${RAGIN_MTLS_CERT_FILE}" \
    -key "${RAGIN_MTLS_KEY_FILE}" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "${TMPDIR}/s_client_edge_to_core.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo S_CLIENT_EDGE_TO_CORE_EXIT=0
  else
    echo S_CLIENT_EDGE_TO_CORE_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo "--- s_client output head ---"
  head -n 80 "${TMPDIR}/s_client_edge_to_core.txt"
  echo "--- openssl x509 peer cert subject/issuer/eku san (no keys) ---"
  if grep -q "BEGIN CERTIFICATE" "${TMPDIR}/s_client_edge_to_core.txt" 2>/dev/null; then
    openssl x509 -noout -subject -issuer -ext subjectAltName,extendedKeyUsage,keyId,authorityKeyIdentifier \
      -in "${TMPDIR}/s_client_edge_to_core.txt" 2>/dev/null || echo PEER_CERT_PARSE_FAILED
  else
    echo PEER_CERT_NOT_RETURNED
  fi
else
  echo PROBE_SKIPPED=no_certs_or_no_openssl
fi
rm -rf "${TMPDIR}"
echo DONE
